lines.en: scene ayhh11
scene dorm
: Coming!
lines.zh: : 来啦!

lines.en: scene black
Ami arrives at the large wooden rectangle currently preventing me from entering her room.
lines.zh: Ami 走到那扇正拦着我进她房间的大型木质矩形前。

lines.en: Most people would refer to this as a “door” but I personally think doors are useless when you could always tear through the wall and force your way into places.
lines.zh: 大多数人会管它叫「门」,但我个人认为门是多余的东西——反正你随时可以撕开墙,强行闯进任何地方。

lines.en: Unless those walls are made of metal.
lines.zh: 除非那些墙是金属做的。

lines.en: In those cases, rare as they may be, tearing through anything will not work.
lines.zh: 那种情况虽然罕见,但硬撕是行不通的。

lines.en: You must find special tools and cut.
lines.zh: 你必须找到特殊工具,切割。

lines.en: Or saw.
lines.zh: 或者锯。

lines.en: Thankfully, I don’t need to do anything like this tonight.
lines.zh: 所幸,今晚我不需要干任何这种事。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood1
: Hi!
: Hey. Where are your pants?
lines.zh: : 嗨。你的裤子呢?

lines.en: : Who cares?
lines.zh: : 谁在乎?

lines.en: : Good point.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : I’m not interrupting any “alone time,” am I?
lines.zh: : 我没有打断什么「独处时光」吧?

lines.en: : It wouldn’t make much of a difference if you were.
lines.zh: : 就算打断了,也没什么区别。

lines.en: : It's not like you haven't already caught me in the act before, right?
lines.zh: : 反正你也不是没当场抓到过我,对吧?

lines.en: : True. But, to be fair, the door was locked. So it's not like that one time really counts or anything.
lines.zh: : 倒也是。不过公平地说,那次门是锁着的。所以那一次其实不算数什么的。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood2
: Of course! Masturbating behind a locked door is basically the same thing as never masturbating at all!
lines.zh: : 没错!锁着门自慰,基本上就等于从未自慰过!

lines.en: : Uhh...sure. That makes sense.
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧。好像很有道理。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood3
: Besides...and this isn't me saying that any of that kind of stuff was gonna happen tonight...but I’m glad you showed up because that means we get to talk instead!
lines.zh: : 再说了……我不是说今晚会有那种事……但我很高兴你来了,因为这意味着我们可以聊天了!

lines.en: : I obviously can’t speak for you, but I personally gain a lot more pleasure from...well, pleasure than casual conversation.
lines.zh: : 显然我无法替你发言,但我个人从……嗯,快感中获得的乐趣,远大于闲聊。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood1
: Who says it has to be casual? Maybe I want to talk about wires what you ate for lunch today or where we go when we die what you ate for lunch today?
lines.zh: : 谁说一定得是闲聊?也许我想聊聊电线、你今天午餐吃了什么,或者我们死后去哪、你今天午餐吃了什么?

lines.en: : That’s a good idea. Let’s talk about what I ate for lunch today.
lines.zh: : 好主意。我们就聊聊我今天午餐吃了什么。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood4
I decide to talk to Ami about what I ate for lunch today.
lines.zh: 我决定跟 Ami 聊聊我今天午餐吃了什么。

lines.en: The conversation falls flat when I realize I can’t remember if I even ate anything at all.
lines.zh: 谈话以失败告终,因为我意识到自己根本想不起今天有没有吃过东西。

lines.en: And that would be no good. Ten out of ten doctors agree that if you don’t eat things, you will likely die.
lines.zh: 这可不太妙。十分之十的医生一致认为:不吃东西,人多半会死。

lines.en: I don’t want to die yet.
lines.zh: 我还不想死。

lines.en: If I die, how will I get to eat lunch tomorrow?
lines.zh: 我要是死了,明天午餐吃什么?

lines.en: : So, Sensei...I’ve been doing some thinking, and I think it would be good if we got a new house together.
lines.zh: : 那么,Sensei……我认真想了想,我觉得我们俩一起买栋新房子会很好。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. Let me just buy a new house in the spur of the moment because you’ve been doing some thinking.
lines.zh: : 哦,行啊。就因为你「认真想了想」,我就头脑一热去买栋新房。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood5
: Yay!
: Ami, we’re not buying a new house.
lines.zh: : Ami,我们不会买新房的。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood6
: AAAaaAAAHAhAHAHAHAAAA!@!!!!!!!!
Ami throws a temper tantrum as if she were a little girl.
lines.zh: Ami 像个小女孩一样发起了脾气。

lines.en: The only thing is that I can’t personally confirm if it’s the same type of tantrum she’d throw when she was really little because her parents didn’t die until she was seven.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是,我无法亲自确认这是不是她真正的幼年时期会发的那种脾气——毕竟她的父母直到她七岁才去世。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood4
: Aren’t you going to ask the reason I wanted to buy a new house, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你不问问我想买新房的理由吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : I wasn’t planning on it since it definitely isn’t going to happen, but sure.
lines.zh: : 我没打算问,因为这事绝对不会发生。不过你请。

lines.en: : Because I love you!
lines.zh: : 因为我爱你!

lines.en: : That is not a suitable reason for a purchase that large.
lines.zh: : 这不是一个适合大额消费的理由。

lines.en: : But if we get a bigger house, there will be a larger number of square feet in which we can get our love all over each other.
lines.zh: : 但要是我们买了更大的房子,可以「把爱互相蹭满全身」的平方英尺,也会成倍增加。

lines.en: : We haven’t even gotten our love all over our current house yet.
lines.zh: : 现在这栋房子,我们都还没蹭满呢。

lines.en: : Well then hurry up and pour it all over me, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 那就快点把我蹭满啊,[amimaster]。

lines.en: : Fill buckets and buckets with your love juice and dump it right onto my adorable little head.
lines.zh: : 装了一桶又一桶你的爱之汁液,直接泼在我可爱的小脑袋上。

lines.en: : We can even leave the front door open so if somebody shows up, they can catch us in the act and then probably cry because everyone thinks they love you for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我们甚至可以把大门敞开,谁要是来了,就能当场抓个正着——然后多半会哭,因为不知为什么所有人都自以为爱你。

lines.en: : Wow. You’re even more possessive than normal today.
lines.zh: : 哇。你今天占有欲比平时还强。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood7
: Do you really not want a new house, though? Even though our current one is filled with sad memories?
lines.zh: : 不过你真的不想要新房吗?哪怕现在这栋房子里装满了悲伤的回忆?

lines.en: : There are good memories too. I just can’t remember most of them yet.
lines.zh: : 也有好的回忆。只是大部分我还想不起来。

lines.en: : I guess. But doesn’t it get annoying having people just show up all the time when we want to be alone together?
lines.zh: : 也对。但是,当我们想独处时总有人冒出来,你不觉得烦吗?

lines.en: : Ami, can you let me in? I forgot my key...
lines.zh: : Ami,能让我进去吗?我忘带钥匙了……

lines.en: : See what I’m talking about? We’ve barely even gotten each other’s clothes off and Maya is already trying to come between us.
lines.zh: : 看到没?我说什么来着。我们衣服才脱了一半,Maya 就已经开始试图插进我们中间了。

lines.en: : Maya? I didn’t hear Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya?我没听到 Maya 的声音啊。

lines.en: : Are you asleep or something? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 你是睡着了还是怎么了?出什么事了?

lines.en: : Oh. I heard her that time.
lines.zh: : 哦。这次我听到了。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood8
: Hold on, Maya! I’ll be there in a second! Just have to put my underwear back on!
lines.zh: : 稍等,Maya!我马上就来!只要先把内裤穿回去!

lines.en: : Why would you say that? Now I’m either going to have to deal with her calling me disgusting again or hide under the bed until she leaves.
lines.zh: : 你为什么要说这个?现在我要么得听她再骂我一遍恶心,要么就得躲到床底下等她走。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood4
: Well that’s no good. Sometimes, Maya doesn’t leave the room for days. You could very well starve to death, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 那可不妙。Maya 有时候会几天不出房间。你很可能会活活饿死的,[amimaster]。

lines.en: : And if you starve to death, how am I going to ride you cowgirl style anymore?
lines.zh: : 你要是饿死了,我以后还怎么骑你?

lines.en: : Okay, seriously...open the door.
lines.zh: : 好,说真的……把门打开。

lines.en: : Hold on one second, Sensei. I have to go do something really quick.
lines.zh: : 稍等一下,Sensei。我得去处理一点小事。

lines.en: : 了解です。
lines.zh: : 了解です。

lines.en: scene black
Ami gets off the bed and I stare at her butt for a few seconds before she makes it to the door.
lines.zh: Ami 下床走向门口,我用几秒钟欣赏了一下她的臀部。

lines.en: It’s a good butt. The kind that you want to grab and squeeze and then have her jump because you’re actually in a train and she’s never seen you before.
lines.zh: 是个好屁股。属于那种你想一把抓住、用力捏、然后看她吓一跳的类型——前提是你其实在电车上,而她从来没见过你。

lines.en: Lol.
lines.zh: 哈哈。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood9
: Who’s there?
: Are you kidding? It’s me. Open the door.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑吧?是我。开门。

lines.en: : Name and age, please.
lines.zh: : 请报上姓名和年龄。

lines.en: : Maya Makinami, age- Wait, why am I identifying myself for you? Just let me in. I live here.
lines.zh: : Maya Makinami,年——等等,我为什么要向你报身份?让我进去。我住在这里。

lines.en: : Sorry, Maya. But I’m a little busy right now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Maya。我现在有点忙。

lines.en: : Sensei and I haven’t gotten to be alone together as much as I want lately, and you’re kind of getting in the way with all of your knocking.
lines.zh: : Sensei 和我最近独处的时间远远不够,你这样砰砰砸门,实在很碍事。

lines.en: : Sensei is in there?
lines.zh: : Sensei 在里面?

lines.en: : Hey, Maya. What did you eat for lunch today?
lines.zh: : 嘿,Maya。你今天午餐吃了什么?

lines.en: : Don’t ask her that, Sensei. She obviously just ate a WATERMELON.
lines.zh: : 别问她那个,Sensei。她显然刚吃了一个大西瓜。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood10
: Hahahahahahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!

lines.en: scene amihumanblood11
: Open the fucking door.
lines.zh: : 把那扇该死的门打开。

lines.en: : Woah! No one’s ever going to marry you if you have that kind of attitude, Maya.
lines.zh: : 哇!Maya,你这个态度,以后可没人会娶你。

lines.en: : Ami, I’m not kidding.
lines.zh: : Ami,我没在开玩笑。

lines.en: : I don’t know what’s going through your head right now but-
lines.zh: : 我不知道你现在脑子里在想什么,但是——

lines.en: scene amihumanblood12
: Sensei, Maya doesn’t want us to be alone together...
lines.zh: : Sensei,Maya 不想让我们独处……

lines.en: : She thinks we’re up to something weird even though we’re related.
lines.zh: : 她觉得我们「有关系」,哪怕我们是亲戚。

lines.en: : I just want to sit on your lap like I’m a little girl again and talk about lunch, but she’s being meeeeaaaaaan~~~~~
lines.zh: : 我只是想像小时候那样坐你的大腿、聊聊午餐,可她好讨~~~厌~~~~

lines.en: : Maybe we should just let her-
lines.zh: : 也许我们该让她——

lines.en: scene amihumanblood13
: No.
: I don’t want to let her in.
lines.zh: : 我不想让她进来。

lines.en: : This is our time together.
lines.zh: : 这是我们俩的时间。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood9
: Maya, here’s an idea! How about you come back in half an hour or so? There’s something I need to talk to Sensei about.
lines.zh: : Maya,我有个主意!你半小时左右之后再来怎么样?我有事要和 Sensei 谈。

lines.en: : Why? What do you need to talk to him about?
lines.zh: : 为什么?你要跟他谈什么?

lines.en: : Why do you care? You hate Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你在乎什么?你讨厌 Sensei。

lines.en: : Right. He’s horrible. But what do you need to talk to him about?
lines.zh: : 没错。他糟透了。但你要跟他谈什么?

lines.en: : Why do you care?
lines.zh: : 你为什么在乎?

lines.en: : Because if it’s something involving me, I-
lines.zh: : 因为如果那件事和我有关,那我——

lines.en: : Why would it be something involving you?
lines.zh: : 那件事为什么会和你有关?

lines.en: : You’re not secretly hiding some sort of relationship with my [uncle] from me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你没有偷偷瞒着我什么和我 [uncle] 的关系吧?

lines.en: : No! I just-
lines.zh: : 没有!我只是——

lines.en: : Can you just please open the door?...
lines.zh: : 你能把门打开吗?……

lines.en: scene amihumanblood14
: What do you think? Should we open it?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢?我们该开门吗?

lines.en: menu:
DON’T OPEN THE DOOR
lines.zh: 不要开门

lines.en: : Of course not. We’re not done talking yet.
lines.zh: : 当然不该。我们还没聊完呢。

lines.en: THE DOOR DOES NOT NEED TO BE OPENED
lines.zh: 门不需要被打开

lines.en: : We don’t have to open it. Not if you haven’t said everything you want to say yet.
lines.zh: : 我们不必开门。要是你还没说完想说的话的话。

lines.en: ALL OF THE GOOD THINGS ARE HERE
lines.zh: 所有美好的东西都在这里

lines.en: : All of the good things are already in here. Opening the door would just let the bad things in.
lines.zh: : 所有美好的东西都已经在这间屋子里了。开门只会放坏东西进来。

lines.en: STAY IN THE ROOM ALONE
lines.zh: 一个人待在房间里

lines.en: : We should stay in here without Maya. I don’t feel like talking about the stars.
lines.zh: : 我们应该在这里待着,不带 Maya。我现在不想聊星星。

lines.en: MAYA IS A FUCKING NERD
lines.zh: MAYA 是个该死的书呆子

lines.en: : Maya’s a fucking nerd. She can wait in the hall.
lines.zh: : Maya 是个该死的书呆子。让她在走廊等着吧。

lines.en: STAY WITH YOUR NIECE
lines.zh: 和你的侄女待在一起

lines.en: : I would rather be with my [niece] alone. She’s the only one who understands me.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿和我的 [niece] 单独待着。她是唯一懂我的人。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood9
: Well, there you have it. Please come back later after Sensei and I are done loving each other.
lines.zh: : 好了,就是这样。等 Sensei 和我恩爱完毕,请之后再过来。

lines.en: : As [niece] and [uncle], of course. We’d neeeeeeeeeeeeeeever be anything more than that.
lines.zh: : 以 [niece] 和 [uncle] 的名义,当然。我们永远、永远不会超越那层关系。

lines.en: : I am a respectable man with morals and-
lines.zh: : 我是一个有道德的体面人,而且——

lines.en: : OPEN THE FUCKING DOOR!
lines.zh: : 把那扇该死的门打开!

lines.en: scene black
Ami and I slowly back away from the wooden rectangle and Maya, who doesn’t appear to know that you can just cut your way into rooms, ultimately retreats.
lines.zh: Ami 和我慢慢退离那个木质矩形;而 Maya 显然不知道你可以直接切墙进来,最终退走了。

lines.en: Either that or she goes silent and slopes downward in the hall to [masturbate] to the thought of an [incest]uous [uncle]/[niece] pairing.
lines.zh: 又或者,她只是没了声音,顺着走廊滑倒在地,对着「[uncle]/[niece] 这对 [incest] 组合」的念头开始 [masturbate]。

lines.en: if day < 5:
The only thing is that there are other girls in the hallway today and, if any of them saw her touching herself out there, they’d probably say something.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是,今天走廊里还有其他女孩。她们任何一个要是看到她在那里动手,大概都会说点什么。

lines.en: Unless it’s Rin. If it’s Rin, she’ll probably offer to finger Maya herself.
lines.zh: 除非那是 Rin。要是 Rin,她多半会主动提出帮 Maya 手。

lines.en: And then she’ll probably convince herself she’s fallen in love with her too.
lines.zh: 然后她多半会说服自己,自己也爱上了 Maya。

lines.en: They’d make a cute couple.
lines.zh: 她们会是挺可爱的一对。

lines.en: else:
Thankfully, there’s no one else in the hall right now (At least to my knowledge), so she’d be able to get away with it.
lines.zh: 所幸此刻走廊里没有别人(至少据我所知),她勉强能全身而退。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood4
: So, now that we’ve gotten rid of Maya, there are a few more things I’d like to talk about.
lines.zh: : 那么,既然 Maya 已经被打发走了,还有几件事我想跟你聊聊。

lines.en: : Are you in the right mindset yet, [amimaster]? Or do you need a little more time to regain your footing?
lines.zh: : 你找回状态了吗,[amimaster]?还是需要一点时间站稳脚跟?

lines.en: : Right mindset? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 找回状态?什么意思?

lines.en: : I just got here, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我不是刚来吗?

lines.en: : Right. You knocked on the door and immediately came to sit on my bed with me.
lines.zh: : 对。你敲了门,然后立刻过来坐在我床上。

lines.en: : Nothing happened in between those two things. And everything is completely okay now.
lines.zh: : 这两件事之间什么都没有发生。而现在一切都完全好了。

lines.en: : You’re completely okay now. Ami’s got you.
lines.zh: : 你现在完全好了。Ami 会照顾你的。

lines.en: : You’re being kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 你有点怪怪的。

lines.en: Ami sits up on the bed, fixing her posture but spreading her legs apart more.
lines.zh: Ami 在床上坐起身,摆正姿势,却把双腿张得更开了。

lines.en: She smells faintly of shampoo so I imagine she just took a shower.
lines.zh: 她身上有淡淡的洗发水味,我猜她刚洗过澡。

lines.en: And, on another note, I feel strangely out of place right now.
lines.zh: 另外,我此刻有一种奇异的疏离感。

lines.en: Have you ever found yourself in a situation where you think you’re there, but you’re not really there?
lines.zh: 你有没有遇到过这种情况:你觉得自己在场,但其实并不真的在场?

lines.en: Like you can comprehend the things hanging around you, but all of them are swaying so rapidly that you can’t find it in yourself to burn them into your mind.
lines.zh: 你能理解周围悬着的一切,但它们晃动得太快,你没办法把它们烙进心里。

lines.en: To etch them into the gray walls of your cerebral cortex and really start to understand exactly what is happening and not just “what’s happening.”
lines.zh: 烙进你大脑皮层的灰色墙壁上,真正开始理解「到底」发生了什么,而不只是「发生了什么」。

lines.en: This is one of those times.
lines.zh: 现在就是那种时刻之一。

lines.en: So, I slap myself in the face and put myself back into serious mode, because I’m pretty sure Ami wants to have an actual conversation about something more than just relocating right now.
lines.zh: 于是,我扇了自己一巴掌,把自己切回严肃模式——我很确定 Ami 现在想认真聊的,远不止搬家。

lines.en: : We’re both being kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都有点怪怪的。

lines.en: : We do that sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我们偶尔会这样。

lines.en: : But we’ve seen and felt horrible things together, so we share a bond that not many other people do.
lines.zh: : 但我们一起见过、一起感受过可怕的事,所以我们共享着一种别人没有的羁绊。

lines.en: : It’s a bond that makes it okay for the two of us to “black out” at times.
lines.zh: : 正是这种羁绊,让我们俩偶尔「断片」也无妨。

lines.en: : I think that’s how we used to describe it in the past, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 过去我们好像就是这么形容它的,对吧?

lines.en: : If you remember the past at all, that is.
lines.zh: : 如果你还记得过去的话。

lines.en: : Your memory has never been that good, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 你的记性向来不怎么样,[amimaster]。

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I can’t even tell if it’s been getting better or worse lately.
lines.zh: : 完全坦白地说,我甚至分不清它最近是在变好还是变坏。

lines.en: : It’s like every time I start to remember something, there’s a brief flash and TV static.
lines.zh: : 就好像每次我开始想起什么,就会有一道闪光和一片电视雪花。

lines.en: scene neg1
scene amihumanblood4
: Like that.
lines.zh: : 就像那样。

lines.en: : That’s completely normal. And it’s okay for you to feel that way.
lines.zh: : 这完全正常。你有那种感觉也没关系。

lines.en: : Because, even if you start doing weird stuff, it’s not like I’ll ever say no to anything.
lines.zh: : 因为,就算你开始做奇怪的事,我也永远不会对你说「不」。

lines.en: : You could honestly pin me down and ravage me in the middle of[school] one day and I’d lay there and take it like the good girl I am.
lines.zh: : 说真的,你就算哪天在 [school] 中间把我扑倒、 ravage 我,我也会乖乖躺在那里承受,像我这只好女孩该做的那样。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s a thing that will be happening any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这种事近期会发生。

lines.en: : Of course it won’t be happening any time soon. Or probably ever.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。甚至永远不会。

lines.en: : There are too many people who would be hurt by it.
lines.zh: : 会因此受伤的人太多了。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood15
: You know, one of the many many many many many many many reasons I love you is because, even though you pretend not to, you really do care about everyone.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我爱你的理由成千上万个,其中一个就是:你虽然假装不在乎,其实你真的在乎每一个人。

lines.en: : You’ve always been that way. It’s the same reason you decided to take in an orphaned girl when she had nowhere else to go.
lines.zh: : 你一直都是这样。这也是为什么,当年一个孤女走投无路的时候,你决定收留她。

lines.en: : Even when you were just as sad as her and had broken into a million pieces of your own.
lines.zh: : 哪怕那时的你和她一样悲伤,自己也碎成了百万片。

lines.en: : And so we did what we had to do and finished each other’s puzzles.
lines.zh: : 于是我们做了该做的事,替彼此拼完了各自的拼图。

lines.en: : You were what I needed you to be, and I was what you needed me to be.
lines.zh: : 你成为了我需要的你,我成为了你需要我。

lines.en: : Everything else was just static.
lines.zh: : 其他的一切都只是雪花噪点。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood16
: But once that static got louder...that’s when things started getting weird.
lines.zh: : 但当那些噪点越来越响……事情就开始变怪了。

lines.en: : I’m guessing that’s when you started realizing you were in love with me?
lines.zh: : 我猜,那时候你开始意识到你爱上我了?

lines.en: : That’s not what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是那个。

lines.en: : I’m talking about when you started going back to normal.
lines.zh: : 我说的是,你开始恢复正常的时候。

lines.en: : When you stopped being so sad all the time and started putting things back together without my help.
lines.zh: : 当你不再一直悲伤,开始不需要我的帮忙,自己把一切拼回去的时候。

lines.en: : It was nice seeing you learn to walk again, but I missed having to be the little girl who would hold you up with her big hugs and her infectious smile.
lines.zh: : 看着你重新学会「走路」很美好,但我也怀念当那个小女孩的日子——用大大的拥抱和有感染力的笑容撑住你。

lines.en: : I don’t want to say you were drifting away because we were still really close-
lines.zh: : 我不想说你正在远去,因为我们还是很亲密——

lines.en: : But I could tell there was something else there. Something that was preventing us from being closer.
lines.zh: : 但我看得出来,有些别的东西横在我们之间。阻止我们更靠近的东西。

lines.en: : You started coming home a little later some nights.
lines.zh: : 有几个晚上,你开始晚一点回家。

lines.en: : And then even later than that some other nights.
lines.zh: : 再后来,有几个晚上,更晚。

lines.en: : And it didn’t really occur to me until a couple years ago, but that wasn’t just because of tutoring, was it?
lines.zh: : 直到几年前我才隐约意识到——那不只是家教,对吧?

lines.en: : I...honestly have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我……真的一点都不知道。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood4
: How come you never really tutored anyone at our house, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那时候你怎么从不在家里辅导学生,Sensei?

lines.en: : I already told you. I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我已经说了。我完全不知道。

lines.en: : But if I had to take a guess, it’s because it would have been weird to invite girls of that age over to a middle-aged guy’s house without parental supervision.
lines.zh: : 但如果非要猜,大概是因为——没有家长在场,把那个年纪的女孩约到一个中年男人家里,怎么想都太怪了。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine any of those parents would be thrilled about that either.
lines.zh: : 我也想象不出那些家长哪个会乐意。

lines.en: : Are you sure you weren’t just trying to keep your “work” life and your personal life separate?
lines.zh: : 你确定你只是想把「工作」生活和个人生活分开?

lines.en: : Again, I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,我不知道。

lines.en: : You don’t know?
lines.zh: : 你不知道?

lines.en: : No. And why are you asking about this right now?
lines.zh: : 不知道。你为什么现在问这个?

lines.en: : What does what I did for work back then have to do with us?
lines.zh: : 我当年靠什么谋生,和我们俩有什么关系?

lines.en: : This is hardly normal [uncle]/[niece] bonding, Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami,这可不是什么正常的 [uncle]/[niece] 谈心。

lines.en: : I guess it is a little random to talk about it out of nowhere like this, but I’ve been thinking really hard about some stuff lately.
lines.zh: : 这样没头没尾地聊确实有点突兀,但我最近一直在拼命想一些事。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s not true, but I keep thinking that maybe something happened with you while I wasn’t around that hurt you really bad.
lines.zh: : 我相信不是真的,但我总忍不住想:也许在我看不到的地方,发生过什么把你伤得很深的事。

lines.en: : Because, somewhere along the line, you gave up on tutoring. And I never really understood why.
lines.zh: : 因为,不知道从哪天起,你放弃了家教。而我从来都不明白为什么。

lines.en: : Probably because it didn’t pay well enough to support taking care of you.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为那份收入不够养活你我吧。

lines.en: : Would the answer really be that simple? Or would it be something a little more complicated?
lines.zh: : 真相真的会那么简单吗?还是说,会比这复杂一点?

lines.en: : Complicated?
lines.zh: : 复杂?

lines.en: : Like Noriko, maybe?
lines.zh: : 比如,Noriko?

lines.en: : I mean. Noriko is definitely complicated, but I don’t think I’d ever quit tutoring because of her.
lines.zh: : 嗯,Noriko 确实复杂,但我不觉得我会因为她放弃家教。

lines.en: : Maybe Maya then?
lines.zh: : 那就是 Maya?

lines.en: : Maya is also complicated, but I don’t think I’d quit over tutoring her-
lines.zh: : Maya 也复杂,但我不觉得我会因为给她做家教而辞职——

lines.en: : But you never tutored Maya.
lines.zh: : 可是你从来没有给 Maya 做过家教。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等,什么?

lines.en: scene amibreak3
scene amihumanblood17
: You never tutored Maya, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你从来没有教过 Maya,Sensei。

lines.en: : She wasn't one of your students.
lines.zh: : 她不是你的学生。

lines.en: : You didn’t meet her until I started bringing her home in middle[school].
lines.zh: : 直到我上初中 [school] 开始把她带回家,你们才第一次见面。

lines.en: : Unless you were hiding her from me, that is.
lines.zh: : 除非,你一直在瞒着我认识她。

lines.en: : But why would you be hiding another girl my age from me when I could have become friends with them?
lines.zh: : 可你为什么要瞒着我、藏起一个和我同龄的女孩?我本来还可以和她们做朋友的。

lines.en: : You had no problems with Ayane when I started bringing her home.
lines.zh: : 我开始把 Ayane 往家带的时候,你对她可没有任何意见。

lines.en: : Have you actually known Maya this whole time?
lines.zh: : 这么多年,你其实一直认识 Maya?

lines.en: : Have you just been pretending not to know her?
lines.zh: : 你一直都在假装不认识她?

lines.en: : And if so, why?
lines.zh: : 如果是这样,为什么?

lines.en: : I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 我不理解。

lines.en: Now that I think about it, every time I’ve tried talking to Ami about Maya’s past, she’s seemed almost completely oblivious.
lines.zh: 现在回想起来,每次我试图跟 Ami 聊 Maya 的过去,她都表现得近乎一无所知。

lines.en: Ayane, too.
lines.zh: Ayane 也是。

lines.en: Neither of them knew anything about her family. Just where she came from and when she showed up.
lines.zh: 她们对她的家庭一无所知。只知道她从哪来、什么时候出现。

lines.en: : You two don’t like each other. That much is very clear to me.
lines.zh: : 你们俩互相不喜欢。这一点我看得清清楚楚。

lines.en: : So why, if you have known each other for that long, are you pretending not to?
lines.zh: : 所以,如果你们认识那么久,为什么要假装不认识?

lines.en: scene amibreak3
scene amihumanblood17
: Do you think that maybe someone is just playing a trick on you, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 你觉得,会不会有人在你身上搞鬼,[amimaster]?

lines.en: : Do you think that someone could be taking advantage of your bad memory to make you think things are real that aren’t actually real?
lines.zh: : 你觉得,会不会有人正利用你糟糕的记忆,让你把不存在的东西当成真的?

lines.en: : Do you know what is real, though?
lines.zh: : 可你知道什么才是真的吗?

lines.en: scene amibreak3
scene amihumanblood17
: The past you have with me.
lines.zh: : 是你和我共有的过去。

lines.en: : Not the past of girls that you’d see during designated hours five or six days a week.
lines.zh: : 不是那些一周有五或六天、在指定时间才能见到的女孩们的过去。

lines.en: : The past you have with the girl who would bleach the maggots out of your room for you or sponge bathe you when you couldn’t bring yourself to get out of bed.
lines.zh: : 是那个会帮你把蛆虫从房间里清出去的女孩的过去;是你下不了床时,用海绵替你擦洗身体的女孩的过去。

lines.en: : That past is real.
lines.zh: : 那个过去是真的。

lines.en: : Tell me you see me.
lines.zh: : 告诉我你看到的是我。

lines.en: scene amibreak3
scene amihumanblood17
: Tell me you see me, not the fake memories of someone else who thinks they love you.
lines.zh: : 告诉我你看到的是我,不是某个自以为爱你的人的伪造记忆。

lines.en: : When you love someone, you don’t have to hide it.
lines.zh: : 爱一个人的时候,不需要隐藏。

lines.en: : So either everything is fake...or you’ve been hiding something very bad from me for a very long time...
lines.zh: : 所以,要么一切都是假的……要么,你已经瞒着我一件很坏很坏的事,瞒了很久很久……

lines.en: scene amihumanblood4
: Or you’re just misremembering and talked about tutoring Maya on accident!
lines.zh: : 又或者你只是记岔了,是不小心说漏嘴说成了给 Maya 做家教!

lines.en: : In fact, since your memory is so bad, I’m sure that’s exactly what happened.
lines.zh: : 事实上,既然你的记性那么差,我敢肯定就是那样。

lines.en: : So I won’t annoy you about it any more.
lines.zh: : 所以我不再拿这个烦你了。

lines.en: : At least not until something else slips out that makes me think, “Hmm...is my [uncle] less amazing than I thought he was?”
lines.zh: : 至少在我下次从你嘴里听到别的什么、让我开始想「嗯……我的 [uncle] 是不是没有我想的那么了不起?」之前。

lines.en: : Because right now, I still think you’re the most amazing, most handsome person in the entire world.
lines.zh: : 因为此时此刻,我依然认为你是全世界最了不起、最英俊的人。

lines.en: : With the biggest penis of all time.
lines.zh: : 带着史无前例最大号 penis 的人。

lines.en: : And I want to have cute [incest] babies with you and watch them live long, happy, healthy lives.
lines.zh: : 我想和你生可爱的 [incest] 宝宝,看着他们健康快乐地长寿下去。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood8
: Oh! Maya’s back!
lines.zh: : 哦!Maya 回来了!

lines.en: scene amihumanblood18
: Oh. And you’re here, too.
lines.zh: : 哦。你也在。

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining why I had to use my key to unlock your door when you’re clearly capable of opening it on your own?
lines.zh: : 你能解释一下,为什么你明明能自己开门,却害得我不得不用钥匙开你的门吗?

lines.en: : It’s fine to have fights with your roommates, but dragging me into them is just a waste of my time.
lines.zh: : 室友吵架没关系,但把我拖下水,纯属浪费我的时间。

lines.en: : What happened in here?
lines.zh: : 里面发生了什么?

lines.en: : I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 我也不确定。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood19
: Well, whatever it was, please keep a tighter leash on your [niece].
lines.zh: : 好吧,不管发生了什么,请把你的 [niece] 管紧一点。

lines.en: : I would love that.
lines.zh: : 求之不得。

lines.en: : Please.
lines.zh: : 拜托了。

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : Yes, Maya?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,Maya?

lines.en: : I already told you there’s nothing going on. You didn’t need to go this far to prove-
lines.zh: : 我已经告诉你了我们之间什么都没有。你没必要做到这个地步来证明——

lines.en: : Hm? Sensei and I just talked about lunch and stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯?我和 Sensei 只是聊了聊午餐什么的。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: scene amihumanblood20
: I think it’s probably best if we leave the two of them to resolve this on their own.
lines.zh: : 我觉得,最好还是让她们俩自己解决这件事。

lines.en: : You’re clearly involved in this somehow and-
lines.zh: : 你显然被卷进去了,而且——

lines.en: : Sensei isn’t involved at all. He was just spending time with his favorite girl in the world.
lines.zh: : Sensei 根本没有卷进去。他只是陪着全世界他最喜欢的女孩待了一会儿。

lines.en: : Makoto’s right, though. I definitely think I should start heading home for the night.
lines.zh: : 不过 Makoto 说得对。我确实觉得我今晚该回家了。

lines.en: : I’m sad, but I understand.
lines.zh: : 我很难过,但我理解。

lines.en: : I’ll see you in the morning, though. I bought chocolate chips for pancakes, too, so expect a really big breakfast!
lines.zh: : 不过早上见。我买了巧克力豆,可以放松饼里——等着迎接一顿超大的早餐吧!

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : That sounds great...
lines.zh: : 听起来太棒了……

lines.en: scene black
What exactly happened tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚到底发生了什么?
